newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Guoco signs deals to buy Pepsi Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Guoco signs deals to buy Pepsi Philippines.

text.p: Guoco Holdings (Philippines) Inc said on Monday it had signed a memorandum of agreement with the majority stakeholders of Pepsi-Cola Products Philippines Inc (PCPPI), the franchise holder of Pepsi products.

Corporate Secretary Daisy Parker said Guoco agreed to buy the 51.5 percent stake of PCPPI held by Macondray Holdings Corp and Premiere Beverages Philippines Inc either directly or through an affiliate.
The final sale of Macondray and Premier shares will be subject to certain conditions to be finalised with lawyers of franchisor PepsiCo Inc and due diligence to be undertaken by Guoco.

"Guoco will, on the closing (of the deals), own 100 percent of the capital stock of Premier, a corporation which holds about 51.5 percent of the capital stock of PCPPI, as well as a direct investment of about 2.7 percent in PCPPI," Parker said.
